Read a guest file through the transfer agent.

```text
pomme cat PATH [--offset OFFSET] [--count COUNT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PATH` | `NAME:/absolute/path` endpoint. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--offset OFFSET` | Starting byte offset. Default: `0`. |
| `--count COUNT` | Maximum bytes to read. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
